c-gating-rule-never-locks-out.1.evidence: Fresh subscriber on a public open space (QA-WALK-B3 Open): read 200, POST topic 201, reply 201, vote 200 before any rule.

c-gating-rule-never-locks-out.2.evidence: Admin Access Rules tab: Logged In + Participate, Add Rule -> toast 'Access rule added.'; table lists 'Logged in - Participate'.

c-gating-rule-never-locks-out.3.evidence: Same subscriber after the Logged In rule: read 200, POST topic 201, reply 201; vote on another user's topic 200 (the vote on his own topic gave 400 jetonomy_self_vote, as designed).

c-gating-rule-never-locks-out.4.evidence: Guest GET the public space after the rule -> 200 and the member's topic is visible.

c-gating-rule-never-locks-out.5.evidence: Role rule (subscriber, Read) added in the admin UI -> toast 'Access rule added. This space was switched to Private so the rule can restrict access, and its join policy is now Requires Approval. A rule cannot gate a public space.' (adds the join-policy clause; runbook text is a prefix of it).

c-gating-rule-never-locks-out.6.evidence: Fresh subscriber who never posted (u2) after the switch: space page 200 and lists the topic, no new-topic link, POST topic and reply 403 jetonomy_forbidden 'You cannot post in this space.', vote 403.

c-gating-rule-never-locks-out.7.evidence: Existing roster member (u1) after the Role rule: POST topic 201, vote 200.

c-gating-rule-never-locks-out.8.evidence: Access Rules tab intro: 'A rule lets more people in to this space: anyone who matches it gets what it grants, without being added to the members list. Who else gets in is set by the space's visibility and join policy.'

c-gating-rule-never-locks-out.9.evidence: Subscriber POST /spaces/{id}/access-rules -> 403 jetonomy_forbidden 'Only site administrators can manage access rules for this space.'

c-gating-rule-never-locks-out.10.evidence: test_editor on Help Desk: GET and POST /spaces/3004/access-rules -> 403 jetonomy_forbidden 'Only site administrators can manage access rules for this space.'; the wp-admin tab shows that sentence and a 'Back to Help Desk' link.

c-gating-rule-never-locks-out.11.evidence: 390px Access Rules tab: scrollWidth 390, rule type/grants selects 42px, Add Rule 40px, controls stacked at x=35-36.

c-gating-rule-never-locks-out.12.evidence: Role rule on an open-join public space: join policy changed to Requires Approval; the toast now says so ('...its join policy is now Requires Approval.') but the General tab shows no notice (0 .notice elements), only the new Join Policy value; runbook asks for both.
